registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Control register - includes bridge reset control

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Status register - bridge busy and error code

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.description: Configuration register - baud rate and timeout

registers.name: DEBUG
registers.description: Debug control register - debug mode selection

registers.name: TX_COUNT
registers.description: TX transaction counter (read-only)

registers.name: RX_COUNT
registers.description: RX transaction counter (read-only)

registers.name: FIFO_STAT
registers.description: FIFO status flags (read-only)

registers.name: VERSION
registers.description: Hardware version register (read-only)

registers.name: TEST_0
registers.description: Test register 0 - pure read/write test

registers.name: TEST_1
registers.description: Test register 1 - pattern test

registers.name: TEST_2
registers.description: Test register 2 - increment test

registers.name: TEST_3
registers.description: Test register 3 - mirror test

registers.name: TEST_4
registers.description: Test register 4 - gap test

registers.name: CPU_MEM_ADDR
registers.description: RV32I CPU memory address (32-bit byte address, converted to word address [12:2] internally for 8KB RAM)

registers.name: CPU_MEM_WDATA
registers.description: RV32I CPU memory write data (full 32-bit data)

registers.name: CPU_MEM_RDATA
registers.description: RV32I CPU memory read data (full 32-bit data, captured after read operation)

registers.name: CPU_MEM_CTRL
registers.description: RV32I CPU control and memory access: [3:0]=byte_enables, [4]=read_req(W1P), [5]=write_req(W1P), [6]=busy(RO), [7]=cpu_run, [8]=cpu_halt, [9]=cpu_halted(RO), [10]=cpu_break(RO)

registers.name: DBG_BP0_ADDR
registers.description: Hardware breakpoint 0 address (32-bit PC value, halts CPU when PC matches)

registers.name: DBG_BP1_ADDR
registers.description: Hardware breakpoint 1 address (32-bit PC value, halts CPU when PC matches)

registers.name: DBG_BP2_ADDR
registers.description: Hardware breakpoint 2 address (32-bit PC value, halts CPU when PC matches)

registers.name: DBG_BP3_ADDR
registers.description: Hardware breakpoint 3 address (32-bit PC value, halts CPU when PC matches)

registers.name: DBG_BP_CTRL
registers.description: Breakpoint control: [3:0]=bp_enable(RW), [7:4]=bp_hit_flags(RO), cleared on cpu_run

registers.name: PERF_CYCLE_COUNT
registers.description: Performance counter: total cycles executed (counts when CPU running)

registers.name: PERF_INSN_COUNT
registers.description: Performance counter: total instructions committed (WB stage valid)

registers.name: PERF_STALL_COUNT
registers.description: Performance counter: total pipeline stalls (IF or ID stage stalled)

registers.name: PERF_FLUSH_COUNT
registers.description: Performance counter: total pipeline flushes (branch/jump taken)

registers.name: DBG_RF_ADDR
registers.description: Register file read address: [4:0]=register_address (0-31), read DBG_RF_DATA after setting

registers.name: DBG_RF_DATA
registers.description: Register file read data: 32-bit value of register specified by DBG_RF_ADDR (x0 always returns 0)

registers.name: TRACE_READ_ADDR
registers.description: Trace buffer read address: [5:0]=entry_index (0-63), read TRACE_DATA_* registers after setting

registers.name: TRACE_DATA_LOW
registers.description: Trace entry data [31:0]: lower 32 bits of trace data

registers.name: TRACE_DATA_MID
registers.description: Trace entry data [63:32]: middle-low 32 bits (rd_value)

registers.name: TRACE_DATA_HI0
registers.description: Trace entry data [95:64]: middle-high 32 bits (instruction opcode)

registers.name: TRACE_DATA_HI1
registers.description: Trace entry data [127:96]: upper 32 bits (PC address)

registers.name: TRACE_STATUS
registers.description: Trace buffer status: [5:0]=write_ptr, [13:8]=entry_count, [16]=buffer_full_flag

registers.name: DBG_RESET_CTRL
registers.description: Debug reset control: [0]=soft_reset(W1P), [1]=reset_done(RO), [2]=cpu_step(W1P)

registers.name: REVISION
registers.description: Hardware revision (RV32I-only design, date: 2026-01-03)
